forecasts.derivation: Account S2-S3 (the effect is RL's paired top-8 directions, read from an input subspace shared across layers, and base + 1.5x those directions is RL) says keeping 76-78 % of the paired edit in one common 64-dim subspace per side (result-ce52f8) at the same norm should stay close to the full 1.5x dial at 203/328 (result-6f1bb7), just under it, as the k=64 cell at 200 and the explore ranks 2-8 1.5x cells (194-204 doubled) suggest.

Account S2-S3: the 8 common dimensions keep only ~40 % of the paired edit (result-ce52f8, against 7.5-14.5 % for random), and the norm matching inflates that part, so the cell should land between the rank-1 edit (181 at 1x in result-51a0e7; explore top1x1.5 cells 178-190 doubled) and the full dial's 203, well above the random/unpaired level of 158-164 (result-0d54f3).

Account S5-S6 (votes help the base through scattered slips, but most of RL's vote wins on hard328 have no right base sample) means the cued-base vote curve keeps rising but flattens: 188.5 at 4 and 197 at 6 (result-c065a6), and a posterior-predictive simulation on the stored explore rows (day1_3/hard328_base_cue_s4r2) gives about +4 for 6 to 8, so about 201.
Same account S5-S6 vote curve: the vote over 8 at about 201 minus the vote over 4 at 188.5 (result-c065a6), with the stored explore-row simulation giving roughly +12 from 4 to 8 samples.
